name: Budvar Nealko Lager
description: No alcohol should never mean no flavour. Just as with Budweiser Budvar Original, we brew Nealko using celebrated Moravian barley for a bold, sweet, toasted malt profile, and the same Saaz hops for a lightly spiced, fresh, citrusy aroma with just a hint of bitterness.

name: Budweiser Budvar
description: Budweiser Budvar 0.0% is an alcohol free Czech lager made with the same care and brewing heritage as Budvar’s Original Lager. Brewed with Czech ingredients and gently de alcoholised at the end, it keeps the clean, balanced lager character Budvar is known for. Expect pale malt sweetness, smooth Saaz hop bitterness and a crisp, refreshing finish.

name: Budweiser Zero Lager Beer Vegan
description: Budweiser Zero delivers the iconic taste of Budweiser in a fully alcohol‑free format. Brewed with the same high standards as the original, it offers a light, clean lager profile with subtle malt sweetness and a smooth, refreshing finish. Easy‑drinking and universally familiar, it’s a go‑to choice for those wanting a classic lager experience without the alcohol.

name: BUNTA
description: BUNTA Alcohol Free Beer is a 0.0% non alcoholic lager brewed for clean, easy refreshment. It delivers a light malt base with gentle bitterness and a crisp finish, keeping the flavour simple and balanced. The profile is straightforward and highly drinkable, making it a good option for everyday drinking, social occasions or when you want a lighter alcohol free choice.

name: Bunta Citrus Lager
description: Bunta Citrus Lager is the UK’s first alcohol‑free craft beer created specifically to pair with bold, spice‑led Indian food. Brewed in the UK, this light and refreshing 0.5% lager is crafted with orange peel and coriander seed , mirroring flavour compounds found in Indian cuisine to enhance — not overpower, every bite.

name: Burton Road The Non
description: Burton Road The Non is a 0.0% alcohol free pale ale brewed for easy drinking and proper hop character. The brewery describes it as light and crisp with a tropical hop flavour, giving it a bright, modern profile without pushing too hard into bitterness.

name: Campervan Brewery Off-Piste Pale
description: Off-Piste Pale is Campervan Brewery's low alcohol pale ale, brewed to deliver full craft beer flavour with just 0.5% ABV. Packed with Talus® and Idaho 7® hops, it combines bright grapefruit and lemon notes with subtle tropical fruit character, creating a hazy, refreshing pale ale that's as satisfying as it is sessionable.

name: Carlsberg
description: Carlsberg 0.0% gives you the clean, crisp refreshment of a classic lager without the alcohol. Light, bright and easy drinking, it has that familiar Carlsberg feel with soft malt, gentle hops and a balanced bitter finish. This is a proper fridge beer for lunches, BBQs, match nights and easy midweek drinking.

name: Chouffe Belgian Blonde
description: Chouffe Belgian Blonde is a non alcoholic beer from Belgium. It pours golden blonde with a creamy head and shows fruity esters, light spice and malt sweetness balanced by subtle bitterness. Brewed with Ardennes yeast for authentic Belgian character, it delivers complexity in a low alcohol format.

name: Chouffe Cherry 0.0 Belgian
description: Chouffe Cherry 0.0 is the new alcohol free version of Chouffe’s well known Belgian cherry beer, launching in the UK from April 2026. Public launch coverage confirms it as a 0.0% release, while the official Chouffe Cherry page describes the core flavour profile around ripe cherries, touches of strawberry and almond, a tickle of spice, and a pleasantly bitter balanced mouthfeel.

name: Clausthaler Dry Hopped
description: Clausthaler Dry Hopped is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic lager brewed in Germany. Amber golden with floral, citrus and pine hop character, it offers crisp refreshing taste with balanced bitterness. Brewed under German purity law, it is a distinctive lager style without alcohol.

name: Clausthaler Grapefruit Beer
description: Clausthaler, the pioneer of non-alcoholic malt beverages, brings another exciting innovation to the non-alcoholic category. A 50/50 blend of Clausthaler Original and Grapefruit drink, it is the ultimate refreshment for any occasion. Award Winning Commended This was COMMENDED in the highly acclaimed World Alcohol Free Awards 2025.

name: Clausthaler Grapefruit Radler
description: Clausthaler Grapefruit is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic radler brewed in Germany. Golden pink with zesty grapefruit aroma and refreshing citrus flavour, it is crisp and lightly sweet with balanced finish. Brewed under German purity law, it is best enjoyed chilled with salads or grilled dishes.

name: Clausthaler Lemon Lager
description: Clausthaler Lemon is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic lager brewed with natural lemon flavour. Golden with citrus zest, crisp malt body and refreshing finish, it is brewed in Germany under purity law. A summery alcohol free option best served cold with light meals or snacks.

name: Cold Town AF Hopped Lager
description: Cold Town AF Hopped Lager is a refreshing alcohol-free lager brewed in Edinburgh, combining clean malt character with vibrant hop flavour. Crafted with Cascade, Azacca and Citra hops, it delivers bright tropical, citrus and floral notes balanced by a crisp, refreshing finish.

name: Cold Town AF IPA
description: Cold Town AF IPA is a vibrant alcohol-free IPA brewed in Edinburgh, Scotland. Bursting with citrus and tropical fruit flavours, this modern IPA delivers all the bold hop character you'd expect from a craft beer, balanced by a smooth, refreshing finish. Juicy, flavourful and incredibly easy-drinking, it's designed to give you all the enjoyment of an IPA without the alcohol.

name: Collider Unwind
description: Collider Unwind is a refreshing non alcoholic pale ale brewed to deliver balance, flavour and calm. Combining premium malts with citrus-forward hops, it offers gentle bitterness, soft tropical notes and a smooth, rounded finish. Brewed in small batches using modern techniques, Unwind is designed to provide the satisfaction of a craft pale ale without the alcohol.

name: Cornet Oaked Belgian Blond
description: Cornet Oaked Alcohol Free brings the smooth, rounded character of Cornet Oaked into a lighter alcohol free blond beer. Brewed at 0.3% ABV, it is made from the powerful blond Cornet Oaked, with the alcohol removed and the beer oaked again with oak chips. That extra oak treatment gives it a distinctive soft wood character, with a gentle vanilla note and a smooth creamy finish.

name: Crafty Devil Born Free
description: Crafty Devil Born Free is a 0.5% alcohol free pale ale brewed in Cardiff and designed to deliver proper hop character without compromise. The brewery packs it with Citra, Citra Dynaboost, Citra Cryo and Motueka Hop Kief, giving it a bold aroma, juicy flavour and a bright, modern pale ale profile.

name: Den Os NA Dorst Os Hazy Blond
description: NA Dorst den Os is a characterful alcohol free hazy blond beer with a proper hoppy lift and a fresh Belgian feel. Brewed for flavour rather than compromise, it brings citrus, peach and apricot notes over a smooth malt base, with lively carbonation and a clean dry finish.

name: Deschutes Black Butte
description: Deschutes Black Butte Non Alcoholic takes the rich character of the brewery's legendary Black Butte Porter and brings it to a beer containing less than 0.5% alcohol. This is a proper dark beer rather than a lightweight imitation. Dark Chocolate Malt, wheat, Premium 2 Row, Carapils and Crystal 75 create layers of roasted malt, chocolate and coffee, while Cascade and Tettnang hops provide enough bitterness to keep everything beautifully balanced.

name: DIVIN Chenin Blanc Blonde Lager
description: DIVIN Bière des Vendanges Blonde Lager Chenin Blanc is a unique low-alcohol grape ale that brings together traditional brewing and the elegance of Loire Valley Chenin Blanc grapes. Brewed with Chenin Blanc juice, this golden ale delivers gentle malt and cereal aromas layered with notes of honey, crisp apple, and ripe pear.

name: DIVIN Sauvignon Blanc IPA
description: DIVIN Bière des Vendanges IPA Sauvignon Blanc is a distinctive low-alcohol sour ale brewed with Sauvignon Blanc grape juice. Light golden and slightly hazy in appearance, it combines fruity hop character with the vibrant freshness of Sauvignon Blanc. Delicate citrus and floral notes lead into a crisp, refreshing palate, while a subtle acidity creates a beautifully balanced finish.

name: Drop Bear New World
description: Drop Bear New World is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic lager brewed in the UK. Crisp and golden with floral hop aroma, light malt body and refreshing finish, it mirrors classic lager character without alcohol. Best served chilled with pizza, salads or grilled dishes.

name: Erdinger Weissbier
description: Erdinger Weissbier Alkoholfrei is a 0.5% ABV German non alcoholic wheat beer. Hazy golden with banana, clove and light spice aromas, it offers smooth body and refreshing finish. Brewed under purity law, it is also isotonic, making it popular for both social drinking and sports recovery.

name: Erdinger Wheat Beer
description: A cool glass of ERDINGER Alkoholfrei not only tastes fantastic, but is also healthy thanks to the vitamins B12 and folic acid, as well as the polyphenols it contains. The non-alcoholic drink from Erdinger is not only a real energizer but also low in calories, with just 125 kcal per 0.5-litre bottle, and made exclusively from natural ingredients.

name: Estrella Galicia Lager
description: Estrella Galicia 0.0% is a Spanish alcohol free lager brewed in Galicia. Bright golden with crisp malt, floral hop notes and refreshing clean finish, it delivers authentic lager taste without alcohol. A classic Spanish option best served cold in a tall glass with tapas or seafood.

name: Exhale 'ROAR' Lion's Mane IPA
description: Meet Roar, Exhale's signature IPA infused with the Nootropic Lion’s Mane mushrooms, specifically for those who demand both flavour and function. Perfect for the active, health-conscious individual, Roar delivers a bold and refreshing taste while promoting cognitive clarity and focus.

name: Farm Yard Brew Co Float On Pale Ale
description: Float On is Farm Yard Brew Co's alcohol-free pale ale, brewed to deliver big flavour without compromise. Built on an oat-heavy base for plenty of body and a smooth mouthfeel, it's loaded with Nectaron and Superdelic hops, bringing vibrant citrus character and tropical fruit notes with a refreshing bitterness to finish.

name: Firebrand Brewing Co Shorebreak Hazy Pale
description: This non alcoholic hazy pale from Firebrand Brewing Co delivers soft citrus hops, gentle haze and an easy drinking feel at only 0.5 percent. It has the smooth body and light juiciness you expect from a modern hazy pale, but without the alcohol. Fresh, fruity and session friendly, it is ideal for relaxed evenings or when you want a craft beer experience that stays light and refreshing.

name: Firebrand Little Wave
description: Firebrand Little Wave is a crisp, clean alcohol free lager from Cornwall’s Firebrand Brewing Co. Brewed for easy refreshment, it keeps the feel of a classic lager while staying light, smooth and alcohol free. Expect gentle malt, soft grain, mild hop character and a clean finish that makes it seriously easy to drink.

name: Flotzinger Hell Lager
description: By carefully removing the alcohol, this excellent beer has 50% fewer calories than our Flötzinger Hell. The excellent fresh taste is preserved. A fresh beer experience for everyone who wants to give up alcohol, but not the full-bodied pleasure. Alcohol Free Beers are made just like the alcoholic ones with water, yeast, hops and barley.

name: Flötzinger Hell Lager Helles
description: Flötzinger Hell Alcohol-Free is a faithful rendition of Bavaria’s classic Helles style, brewed by Flötzinger Bräu Rosenheim (est. This 0.5% ABV lager pours a clear straw-gold with a pillowy white head, delivering full-bodied malt flavours featuring bread dough, cracker, and light honey, alongside a subtle hop bitterness.

name: Force Majeure Kriek
description: Force Majeure Kriek is a 0.3% ABV Belgian non alcoholic wheat beer brewed with cherries. Deep red with fruity cherry aroma, light malt body and refreshing tart finish, it is a lively Belgian-style fruit beer without alcohol. Best served chilled with desserts or cheese.

name: Force Majeure Winter Ale Belgian
description: Force Majeure Winter Ale is a Belgian alcohol free winter beer with the freshness of a drinkable blond ale and the warming spice of a seasonal brew. It opens with soft malt and light sweetness before cinnamon, cardamom and chai style spice build through the finish.

name: Früh Kölsch
description: Früh Kölsch 0.0% is a German non alcoholic beer brewed in Cologne. Pale golden with delicate malt sweetness, floral hop aroma and crisp refreshing finish, it mirrors the classic Kölsch style without alcohol. Best served cold in a tall stange glass with salads or light dishes.

name: Gageleer Belgian Blond
description: Gageleer 0.0% is a Belgian alcohol free blond beer with a fresh, gently herbal character. Brewed with gale, also known as bog myrtle, it brings something a little different to the alcohol free beer fridge. It pours pale yellow with a white head and fine bubbles. The aroma is fruity and malty, with subtle spicy notes from the gale and yeast.

name: Gentse Strop Belgian Blond
description: Gentse Strop 0.4% brings the character of a Belgian blond beer into an alcohol free bottle. Brewed by Brouwerij Roman, it has a refreshing, fruity style with enough malt, yeast and hop character to feel like a proper Belgian beer. Expect bright banana and citrus aromas, followed by yeasty spice, soft malt and a subtle hop bitterness.

name: Girls That Grain Oh My Goth Coffee Stout
description: Best Before - 01/11/2026 - Still tastes great Dark chocolate. Oh My Goth Coffee Stout is a velvety, indulgent alcohol‑free stout brewed with ingredients sourced from women‑led producers, including speciality coffee from Girls Who Grind Coffee and premium hops and vanilla from women‑run suppliers.

name: Glen Affric Brewery Trail Pale Ale
description: Affric Trail Alcohol Free Pale Ale. Affric Trail is Glen Affric Brewery's alcohol-free pale ale, brewed using advanced low-alcohol brewing techniques to deliver full craft beer flavour with minimal alcohol. Packed with vibrant citrus and tropical hop notes layered over a smooth malt backbone, it's a refreshing, flavour-forward beer that proves you don't need high ABV to enjoy a proper pale ale.

name: Good Chemistry Ghost Run Pale Ale
description: Good Chemistry Ghost Run is a bright, easy drinking alcohol free pale ale with plenty of hop character and a really fresh, modern feel. It is naturally hazy and packed with tangerine, apricot and grapefruit notes, giving it a juicy citrus edge that keeps it lively from first sip to last.

name: Guinness 0.0 Zero
description: Guinness 0.0 Zero 440ml is a 0.0% ABV alcohol free stout brewed in Ireland. Dark with creamy head, roasted malt, coffee and chocolate flavours, it mirrors the iconic Guinness taste without alcohol. Best served chilled in a pint glass with hearty dishes or cheese plates.

name: Gutmann Hefe Weisse
description: Gutmann Hefe Weisse Alcohol Free is a traditional Bavarian-style wheat beer with less than 0.5% ABV, offering the full Hefeweizen experience without the alcohol. Brewed using wheat, barley, spelt, hops, and yeast, it pours a soft cloudy amber and delivers a harmonious blend of malty sweetness, fruity and spicy yeast notes, and gentle hop character.

name: Haacht Primus
description: Primus 0.4 is a crisp Belgian alcohol free lager from Brouwerij Haacht, made for easy refreshment without the full strength alcohol. Light, clean and highly drinkable, it keeps the familiar Primus lager character in a lighter 0.4% serve. It pours crystal clear and straw yellow, with fresh malt, subtle hop aroma and a lightly grassy edge.

name: Haacht Super 8 Flandrien Belgian Blond
description: Super 8 Flandrien 0.0 brings the character of a Belgian golden blond beer into a crisp alcohol free serve. Brewed by Haacht Brewery, it is fresh, smooth and easy drinking, with enough flavour to feel like a proper Belgian beer rather than a simple lager. Expect light malt, subtle vanilla notes and gentle bitterness, giving it a rounded but refreshing feel.

name: Hammerton CRUNCH AF Peanut Butter Milk Stout
description: This alcohol free version of Hammerton’s famous peanut butter milk stout brings the same bold flavour in a lighter, easy drinking style. It combines roasted malt, chocolate and smooth peanut character for a dessert like stout that stays balanced and not overly sweet.

name: Hawkstone Lager Zero
description: Hawkstone Lager Zero is a clean, refreshing alcohol‑free lager brewed using high‑quality British barley and traditional lagering methods. Inspired by the original Hawkstone recipe, it delivers balanced malt character, gentle hop bitterness and a smooth, easy‑drinking finish, all at 0.0% ABV.

name: Heaps Normal Another Lager
description: Heaps Normal Another Lager is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic lager from Australia. Golden and crisp with light malt sweetness, floral hop aroma and refreshing finish, it delivers classic lager style without alcohol. A refreshing option best served chilled in a tall glass with BBQ or seafood.

name: Heaps Normal Half Day Hazy Pale Ale
description: Heaps Normal Half Day is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic hazy pale ale brewed in Australia. Golden and cloudy with juicy tropical fruit and citrus hop notes, it delivers smooth mouthfeel and refreshing finish. A lively alcohol free pale ale, best served chilled with curries, tacos or salads.

name: Heaps Normal Quiet XPA
description: Heaps Normal Quiet XPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic beer brewed in Australia. Bright golden with citrus, pine and tropical hop character, it delivers crisp refreshing flavour with light bitterness. A modern extra pale ale style without alcohol, best enjoyed cold with burgers or BBQ.

name: HELLO Lager British Helles
description: HELLO Lager British Helles is a modern alcohol‑free take on the classic Helles‑style lager. Smooth, crisp and effortlessly drinkable, it pours pale golden with subtle malt sweetness, gentle herbal hop notes and a clean, refreshing bitterness that carries through the finish.

name: HELLO LAGER Functional Helles
description: HELLO Lager is a crisp, easy drinking alcohol free Helles style lager made for the moments when you want a proper beer without slowing the day down. It pours pale golden with gentle citrus and herbal notes, a smooth clean body, and a lasting bitterness that keeps it feeling fresh from first sip to last.

name: HELLO LAGER Refreshing Lemon Top Functional Helles
description: HELLO Refreshing Lemon Top is a bright, easy drinking alcohol free lager with a lively citrus twist that makes it feel instantly fresh and seriously drinkable. Built on a smooth Helles style base, it brings pale golden colour, soft lemonade notes and zingy citrus, all balanced by a lasting bitterness that keeps it crisp rather than sweet.

name: HELLO Lager Top w/ Grapefruit
description: HELLO Lager Top w/ Grapefruit is a modern alcohol‑free Helles‑style lager with a vibrant citrus twist. Built on a smooth, pale golden lager base, it delivers zesty grapefruit freshness, gentle fruitiness and a clean, lasting bitterness that keeps it crisp, balanced and refreshing.

name: HELLO Lager Top w/ Lemon
description: HELLO Lager Top w/ Lemon is a modern alcohol‑free Helles‑style lager with a refreshing citrus twist. Built on a smooth, pale golden lager base, it delivers soft lemonade notes, zingy lemon freshness and a clean, lasting bitterness that keeps it crisp rather than sweet.

name: HELLO Lager Top w/ Peach
description: HELLO Lager Top w/ Peach is a modern alcohol‑free Helles‑style lager with a soft, juicy stone‑fruit twist. Built on a smooth, pale golden lager base, it combines gentle peach notes with light sweetness and a clean, balancing bitterness that keeps it refreshing and easy to drink.

name: Hoegaarden Radler Lemon
description: Hoegaarden Radler Lemon 0.0% is a bright Belgian alcohol free radler made for easy refreshment. It blends the soft wheat beer character of Hoegaarden with lemon and lime citrus, giving you a lighter, fruitier beer that is made to be served ice cold. This is a good choice when you want something sweeter and more refreshing than a standard lager.

name: Hoegaarden Rosée Belgian Rosé
description: Hoegaarden Rosée 0.0% is a fruity Belgian alcohol free rosé beer with a soft wheat beer base and a bright raspberry twist. Light, refreshing and easy to drink, it brings the familiar Hoegaarden character into a sweeter, fruitier 0.0% serve. Expect raspberry fruit, soft wheat, orange peel and a touch of coriander spice, giving it a lively balance of sweetness, citrus and gentle beer character.

name: Hommel Bier NA Belgian Blond
description: Hommel Bier NA is a Belgian alcohol free blond beer with a proper hoppy character and a clean, refreshing finish. Brewed as the alcohol free version of the well known Hommelbier, it keeps that classic Belgian pale ale feel while coming in at just 0.2% ABV. It pours light amber, with a hoppy aroma, gentle spice and a soft floral lift.

name: Huyghe Delirium Delirio Blonde
description: The new alcohol free light blonde beer from Huyghe, with a fine foam head, light malty aroma with spicy and fruity notes. Spiced, full-bodied and round flavour with a fruity and hoppy aftertaste. The full pleasure of a blond, multi-grain special beer, without the alcohol.

name: Huyghe Paranoia Belgian Hazy Blond
description: Paranoia Alcohol Free is a hazy Belgian blond beer from Huyghe Brewery, the team behind Delirium. Brewed at 0.3% ABV, it brings a modern hoppy edge to a Belgian alcohol free beer, with Citra and Mosaic hops added during cold lagering for extra aroma. It pours hazy blond and unfiltered, with citrus notes, soft fruit character and a dry, refreshing finish.

name: Insel Brauerei Snorkeler's Sea Salt
description: Insel Brauerei Snorkeler's Sea Salt is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in Germany. Golden and hazy with citrus and tropical hop notes, it is uniquely brewed with a touch of sea salt for crisp finish. A distinctive IPA alternative best enjoyed chilled with seafood or salads.

name: Insel Brauerei Surfer's Summer
description: Insel Brauerei Surfer's Summer Ale is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in Germany. Golden with citrus zest, tropical fruit and floral hop notes, it delivers refreshing flavour over light malt base. A summery pale ale without alcohol, best served chilled with salads or grilled food.

name: Jever 'Fun' Pilsner
description: Jever Fun is the ideal drink for those who have a taste for genuine beer. Jever Fun is brewed as a full beer. Only then is the alcohol removed by a particularly gentle process, whereby the typical beer aromas are retained - without sugar and just 43 calories. This creates a fries-herbe-alcohol-free pleasure experience with character: distinctive.

name: Jump Ship Dazzle Azacca IPA
description: Jump Ship Dazzle Ship Azacca IPA puts one of North America’s most expressive hop varieties firmly in the spotlight. Generously dry hopped with Azacca, this colourful alcohol free IPA is bursting with ripe mango, papaya, zesty tangerine and sweet pineapple. The generous tropical fruit character is balanced by a clean, crisp finish, making it refreshing, satisfying and wonderfully easy to drink.

name: Jump Ship Flying Colours Amber Ale
description: Jump Ship Flying Colours, the award-winning alcohol free amber ale, is now sailing into larger 440 ml cans. Brewed in Scotland by Jump Ship Brewing, it is a full-flavoured, malt-rich ale for those who love classic British beer character without the alcohol. Made with a blend of pale and caramel malts and balanced British hops, it pours deep amber with aromas of toffee, citrus and biscuit.

name: Jump Ship Haar New England
description: Jump Ship Haar is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic New England IPA brewed in Scotland. Hazy golden with tropical fruit, citrus and stone fruit hop character, it offers juicy flavour and soft mouthfeel. A refreshing NEIPA without alcohol, perfect served cold with spicy dishes or light meals.

name: Jump Ship Harlequin IPA
description: Just 0.5% ABV Harlequin IPA (formerly Dazzle Ship No.3) is Jump Ship’s vibrant alcohol‑free IPA, bursting with pineapple, zesty marmalade and candied fruit from the expressive British‑grown Harlequin® hop. Crafted using advanced dealcoholisation for full‑strength flavour, it delivers a succulent, fruit‑forward profile with a refreshing bitterness and a clean finish.

name: Jump Ship Jackstaff
description: Jump Ship Jackstaff is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in Scotland. Golden amber with citrus, pine and floral hop aromas, it has firm bitterness and smooth malt backbone. A bold IPA style without alcohol, best enjoyed chilled with curries, burgers or pizza.

name: Jump Ship Ocean Drift Cherry Sour
description: Jump Ship Ocean Drift Cherry Sour is a bright, juicy alcohol free sour inspired by the classic flavours of Belgian Kriek. Lacto fermented on whole cherries, it brings plenty of real fruit character, a sharp tart edge and a refreshing finish. This is a brilliant choice if you want something more lively than a standard lager or IPA.

name: Jump Ship Steamboat Hazy Pale Ale
description: Jump Ship Steamboat is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic hazy pale ale brewed in Scotland. Hazy golden with citrus zest, tropical fruit and pine hop notes, it offers juicy hop flavour with smooth malt body. A refreshing pale ale without alcohol, best served cold with pizza, burgers or BBQ.

name: Jump Ship Stoker's Stout
description: Jump Ship Stoker's Stout is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic stout brewed in Scotland. Dark with roasted malt, coffee and chocolate notes, it has smooth body and balanced bitterness. A satisfying stout without alcohol, best served at 10-12°C with cheese, desserts or hearty dishes.

name: Jump Ship Vitamin Sea Radler
description: Jump Ship Vitamin Sea is a bright, refreshing alcohol free radler made for proper thirst quenching moments. Brewed with a crisp lager base and real lemon juice, it brings sharp citrus, clean malt and a lively finish that is perfect straight from the fridge. This is a brilliant choice when you want something lighter and fruitier than a standard lager, but still with proper beer character.

name: Jump Ship Yardarm
description: Jump Ship Yardarm is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic lager brewed in Scotland. Pale golden with crisp malt character, floral hop notes and refreshing dry finish, it mirrors classic lager style without alcohol. Best served chilled in a tall glass with pizza, salads or BBQ.

name: Kaiserdom Lager
description: Kaiserdom Alcohol Free Lager is a 0.0 % ABV beer brewed in Bamberg, Bavaria. This region is renowned worldwide for its rich brewing tradition. Crisp, clean and refreshing, this German lager captures the authentic flavour of a classic Helles-style beer but without the alcohol.

name: Kasteel Rubus Belgian Raspberry
description: This alcohol-free Belgian fruit beer is brewed with raspberries to deliver a rich, smooth, and approachable style. Built on a soft malt base, it brings ripe raspberry sweetness balanced by gentle acidity and light carbonation. The flavour is full and rounded rather than sharp, making it easy to drink while still feeling indulgent.

name: Kehrwieder 'Miami Grove' Juicy Pale Ale
description: Say hello to Miami Grove , the alcohol-free Juicy Pale Ale that brings the beach to your glass. Brewed by Hamburg’s trailblazing Kehrwieder Kreativbrauerei , this brew is a tribute to the sun-drenched vibes of Miami—where the brewery’s founders first fell in love with the bold creativity of American craft beer.

name: Klokk & Co FRIPA
description: Klokk & Co FRIPA is a fresh, fruity alcohol free IPA from Norway, brewed to give you proper craft beer character without the full strength alcohol. Dry hopped like a proper IPA, it brings bright hop aroma, gentle tropical fruit and a refreshing bitter finish. This is a good choice if you want an alcohol free beer with more bite than a standard lager.

name: Klokk & Co FRIPA Mango IPA
description: Klokk & Co Mango FRIPA is a bright 0.5% alcohol free IPA from Norway, brewed with real mango for a fresh, summery twist. It takes the hoppy character of Klokk & Co’s FRIPA and adds juicy mango purée for a softer, fruitier finish. This is an easy beer to enjoy when you want something more tropical than a standard IPA, but still crisp enough to feel refreshing.

name: Klokk & Co FRIPA Radler Mandarin & Lemongrass IPA
description: Klokk & Co FRIPA Radler Mandarin & Lemongrass is a bright, refreshing alcohol free radler from Norway. Built on Klokk & Co’s FRIPA alcohol free IPA, it blends beer character with lemonade made from real fruit for a lighter, fruitier drink. Mandarin brings soft citrus sweetness, while lemongrass adds a fresh, aromatic lift.

name: Klokk & Co FRIPA Radler Trippel Sitrus IPA
description: Klokk & Co FRIPA Radler Trippel Sitrus is a bright, thirst quenching alcohol free radler from Norway. It blends Klokk & Co’s alcohol free IPA with fruit lemonade, bringing together lemon, lime and orange for a properly zesty citrus hit. This is lighter and juicier than a straight IPA, but still has enough beer character to keep it interesting.

name: Klokk & Co Gringo
description: Klokk & Co Gringo is a fresh 0.5% alcohol free Mexican style lager from Norway, brewed with lime and ginger for a bright, zesty twist. It is light, crisp and easy drinking, with soft malt, a touch of maize smoothness, fresh lime sharpness and gentle ginger warmth.

name: Klokk & Co NADA
description: Klokk & Co NADA is a full bodied 0.5% alcohol free pale ale from Norway, brewed for proper flavour without the full strength alcohol. It brings a fresh hop character with pine, grapefruit and light citrus, balanced by a clean bitterness that keeps it crisp and refreshing.

name: Kompel Alcoholvrij Belgian Blonde
description: Kompel Alcoholvrij is a Belgian alcohol free blond beer with a clean, refreshing character and a proper beer feel. Brewed by Kompel, it keeps the easy drinking charm of a golden blond beer, but brings it down to just 0.2% ABV. It pours golden blond with a lively fruity aroma, followed by light malt sweetness, soft fruit and a dry, thirst quenching finish.

name: Krombacher Pilsner
description: In testing this Krombacher was popular with everyone. The slight sweet aftertaste makes it a really enjoyable thirst quenching drink. The non-alcoholic beer is brewed in the same way, with the same fresh Felsquellwasser® (mountain spring water) and malt content. It then goes through a process of de-alcoholisation developed especially in Krombach, which enables the beer to retain the unique aroma which originates during the brewing process.

name: Krombacher Weizen
description: Krombacher Weizen is a 0.5 % ABV non alcoholic wheat beer from Germany. Brewed in traditional wheat beer style using wheat malt and barley malt with Hallertau hops and wheat yeast, then the alcohol is removed. It offers full wheat beer flavour without alcohol.

name: Kuchlbauer Alkoholfreie Weisse
description: Kuchlbauer Alkoholfreie Weisse is a traditional German alcohol free wheat beer with all the soft, hazy character you would expect from a Bavarian style weissbier. It pours pale gold and naturally cloudy, with a creamy head and a smooth wheat beer body. Expect bready malt, soft banana, light honey and gentle spice, followed by a clean refreshing finish.

name: Kwaremont Belgian Blond
description: Kwaremont 0.0% brings the character of a Belgian blond speciality beer into a proper alcohol free serve. Brewed by Brouwerij De Brabandere, it is blonde, clear and refreshing, with a smooth malty body and a gentle hop edge. This is a great choice if you want something more rounded than a standard alcohol free lager, but still crisp enough for easy drinking.

name: La Corne No Limits NA Belgian Blonde
description: La Corne No Limits NA brings the bold, playful La Corne character into a lighter alcohol free blonde beer. Brewed in Belgium at 0.4% ABV, it has a refreshing golden style with a malty body, a proper bitter edge and a dry aromatic finish. This is a great choice if you want an alcohol free beer with more character than a standard lager, but still easy enough for relaxed drinking.

name: Lakedown Brewing Co 'Sound AF' Best Bitter
description: Lakedown Brewing Co ‘Sound AF’ Alcohol-Free Best Bitter (0.5% ABV) brings the timeless character of a traditional British bitter into the alcohol-free world. Brewed with quality barley, wheat, and hops, this beer delivers a smooth malt backbone, gentle hop bitterness, and a clean, satisfying finish, all in a vegan-friendly, gluten-free brew.

name: Lakedown Brewing Co 'Sound AF' German Pilsner
description: Lakedown Brewing Co ‘Sound AF’ Alcohol-Free German Pilsner (0.5% ABV) is a refreshing take on a classic lager style, brewed for those who love crisp, continental flavour without the alcohol. Expect a light, golden body with delicate malt sweetness, balanced by gentle floral hops and a dry, refreshing finish.

name: Lakedown Brewing Co 'Sound AF' Juicy Pale Ale
description: Lakedown Brewing Co ‘Sound AF’ Alcohol-Free Juicy Pale Ale (0.5% ABV) is a vibrant, hop-forward pale ale bursting with tropical fruit character. Brewed with premium barley, wheat, and hops, it delivers a smooth, juicy mouthfeel and a refreshing finish, all in a vegan-friendly, gluten-free brew.

name: Leffe Blond Belgian Abbey
description: Leffe Blond 0.0% brings the classic Belgian abbey beer feel into a fully alcohol free 0.0% bottle. It has that familiar Leffe character, smooth malt, soft spice and a rounded sweetness, but with a lighter finish made for alcohol free drinking. Expect floral and spicy notes, with vanilla and clove sitting alongside a strong malty body and gentle fruity character.

name: Leffe Bruin Belgian Brown Abbey
description: Leffe Bruin 0.0% brings the richer side of Leffe into a fully alcohol free Belgian brown beer. It pours a deep mahogany brown, with soft roasted malt, gentle sweetness and a smooth, creamy character. This is a lovely choice if you want something darker and rounder than a standard alcohol free lager.

name: Lervig No Worries FYR OPP! Yuzu IPA
description: Lervig No Worries FYR OPP! Yuzu is a 0.5% alcohol free IPA brewed with yuzu juice for a bright, citrus led finish. Made by Lervig in Stavanger, Norway, it brings together light malt, gentle hops and the sharp aromatic edge of yuzu. The result is refreshing, clean and lightly tangy, with enough bitterness to keep it firmly in IPA territory.

name: Lervig No Worries Grapefruit IPA
description: Lervig No Worries Grapefruit IPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in Norway. Hazy golden with citrus zest, grapefruit and tropical hop character, it delivers juicy refreshing taste with smooth finish. A lively IPA without alcohol, best served cold with salads or spicy food.

name: Lervig No Worries Mango
description: Lervig No Worries Mango is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in Norway. Hazy golden with juicy mango, citrus and tropical hop aromas, it offers smooth refreshing finish. A fruit-forward pale ale without alcohol, best served cold with salads or spicy dishes.

name: Lervig No Worries Pilsner
description: Lervig No Worries Pilsner is a 0.5% alcohol free beer from Norway, brewed by one of Europe’s most respected craft breweries. This crisp pilsner captures the essence of a classic lager with soft malt notes, floral hops and a clean, dry finish. Light-bodied and perfectly balanced, it’s refreshing, easy to drink and ideal for any occasion.

name: Lervig No Worries Summer
description: Bring a little sunshine to the fridge with Lervig No Worries Summer. This light and refreshing alcohol free beer is bursting with sweet, exotic fruit flavours, giving every can a relaxed holiday feel. At 0.5% ABV, it is made for sunny afternoons, garden gatherings, barbecues or simply bringing some summer spirit to an ordinary evening.

name: Lindemans Kriek 0.0 Cherry Fruit
description: Lindemans Kriek 0.0 is an alcohol free Belgian cherry fruit beer built around the unmistakable flavour of sour cherries. Lindemans says it uses the same generous amount of freshly pressed cherries and natural aromas as the original, delivering a sparkling ruby red beer with a balanced sweet and tart profile.

name: Lindemans Pecheresse 0.0 Peach Fruit
description: Lindemans Pecheresse 0.0 is an alcohol free Belgian fruit beer built around the flavour of sun ripened peaches. Lindemans describes it as golden blond, slightly cloudy, light and refreshing, with a balance of fruity sweetness and gentle acidity. The brewery also says it is brewed with innovative techniques for 100% flavour and 0.0% alcohol, staying close to the character of the original Pecheresse while removing the alcohol.

name: LOAH Blood Orange IPA
description: LOAH Blood Orange IPA is a vibrant alcohol-free beer that brings a bold twist to a classic West Coast style. Bright, citrusy hops meet the natural sweetness of blood orange for a brew that’s complex yet endlessly drinkable. Floral notes and a clean hop bitterness create harmony in every sip - refreshing, confident, and full of flavour.

name: LOAH Fresh Lime Lager
description: Best Before 01/10/2026 - Still tastes great Zesty lime. LOAH Fresh Lime Lager is a bright, refreshing alcohol-free beer that captures the classic taste of a crisp lager with a twist of natural lime. Light, clean, and delicately balanced, it’s the ultimate thirst-quencher for sunny afternoons, spontaneous tacos, or whenever you crave a beer with a citrusy zip.

name: LOAH Juicy Peach Pale Ale
description: LOAH Juicy Peach Pale Ale is a laid-back, fruit-forward beer that lets peach take centre stage. Brewed in the style of an East Coast pale ale, it’s soft, hazy, and bursting with juicy flavour. Minimal bitterness and a touch of sweetness make this a modern, easy-drinking brew for those hazy afternoons when a soft drink just won’t cut it.

name: Loch Lomond Brewery 'Southern Summit' American Pale Ale (0.5%)
description: Crafted in the heart of Scotland, Southern Summit is Loch Lomond Brewery’s refreshing take on an American Pale Ale—without the alcohol. At just 0.5% ABV, this alcohol-free brew delivers a punch of citrusy hops, balanced bitterness, and a clean, crisp finish that rivals its full-strength counterparts.

name: Lost Pier Nitro Stout
description: Lost Pier Nitro Stout 0.5% is an alcohol free stout brewed with nitrogen to deliver a smooth, creamy texture and classic stout character. Roasted malts provide gentle coffee and cocoa notes, while the nitro format softens bitterness and enhances mouthfeel. Balanced and easy drinking rather than heavy, it offers a clean, modern take on a traditional nitro stout without the alcohol.

name: Lost Pier LOOSER Hazy Pale Ale
description: LOOSER is a hazy low alcohol pale ale brewed for maximum hop flavour with minimal alcohol. Packed with Ekuanot HyperBoost, Mosaic T90 and Riwaka Amplifier hops, it delivers layers of juicy mango and ripe melon character, wrapped up in a soft, hazy body and finished with a clean, moreish bitterness that keeps you coming back for another sip.

name: Lowtide Below Brew Co All Hopped Up
description: Below Brew Co All Hopped Up is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in the UK. Pale golden and hazy with bold tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop character, it balances juicy flavour with crisp finish. Crafted in small batches, it is best served cold in a tulip glass with spicy dishes, curries or pizza.

name: Lowtide Below Brew Co Unruly AF
description: Below Brew Co Unruly AF is a bold 0.5% alcohol free pale ale brewed in collaboration with Electric Bear. Packed with Citra, Mosaic and Idaho 7 hops, it brings bright citrus, tropical fruit and a peach iced tea style freshness in a smooth, easy drinking 440ml can.

name: Lowtide Below Brew Co Wild Juice Chase
description: Below Brew Co Wild Juice Chase is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in the UK. Bright golden with tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop aromas, it has a crisp malt body and refreshing finish. A lively alcohol free pale ale best enjoyed chilled with salads, BBQ or spicy dishes.

name: Lucky Saint Hazy
description: Lucky Saint Hazy IPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in the UK. Hazy golden with tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop character, it balances juicy flavour with smooth malt body. A refreshing alcohol free IPA best served chilled with spicy dishes, pizza or BBQ.

name: Lupulus Placebo Low Alcohol Belgian Blonde
description: Lupulus Placebo Low Alcohol is a fruity Belgian blonde beer with proper aroma, light body and a crisp 0.4% finish. Brewed by Les 3 Fourquets, it brings a bright hop character without losing that smooth Belgian beer feel. Expect passion fruit, peach, grapefruit and pineapple on the nose, with Nectaron and Citra hops adding a fresh tropical lift.

name: Madri Exceptional Zero Premium Lager
description: Madri Excepcional Zero brings the bold spirit of Madrid to the alcohol-free world. Brewed using cutting-edge alcohol removal technology , it delivers the same crisp, clean taste and smooth finish as the original, without compromise. Light, balanced, and full of flavour, it’s a refreshing choice for any occasion.

name: Maisels Weisse
description: Maisel's Weisse Alkoholfrei is a 0.5% ABV German non alcoholic wheat beer. Hazy golden with banana, clove and spice yeast character, it delivers smooth body and refreshing finish. Brewed under purity law, it is also isotonic and vitamin-rich, ideal for sports recovery as well as social drinking.

name: Mash Gang 'Journey Juice' Fruited IPA
description: Bold, Juicy, and Built for Adventure Take your taste buds on a wild ride with Journey Juice , the alcohol-free Fruited IPA from the boundary-pushing brewers at Mash Gang . Packed with tropical fruit flavour and a hoppy punch, this 0.5% ABV brew delivers all the attitude of a full-strength IPA—without the booze.

name: Mash Gang Chug XPA
description: Mash Gang Chug XPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic extra pale ale brewed in the UK. Pale golden with citrus zest, tropical fruit and pine hop character, it delivers juicy hop flavour over smooth malt base. A refreshing XPA style best served chilled with pizza, burgers or spicy dishes.

name: Mash Gang Glug
description: Mash Gang Glug <0.5% is a classic cerveza style lager reimagined without alcohol. Brewed with a clean fermentation profile and a carefully balanced malt bill containing corn, it delivers subtle grain complexity with a light masa like note. Hop driven lime and gooseberry bring freshness and lift, while the intentionally crisp finish keeps it sharp and highly drinkable.

name: Mash Gang Lesser Evil
description: Mash Gang - Lesser Evil is a cherry chocolate non alcoholic stout that redefines what alcohol free beer can taste like. Crafted by the innovative UK brewers at Mash Gang, this is a dark beer with dessert-level depth. Expect luscious layers of rich cocoa, sweet dark cherry, and subtle roasted malt.

name: Menabrea Zero
description: Menabrea Zero Zero is a 0.0% ABV Italian alcohol free lager. Pale golden with crisp malt character, floral hop balance and refreshing finish, it mirrors the taste of classic Menabrea lager. Best served chilled in a tall glass with Mediterranean dishes or light meals.

name: Meteor IPA
description: Meteor IPA 0.0% is a French alcohol free IPA brewed in Alsace. Golden amber with tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop aromas, it delivers refreshing hop flavour with balanced bitterness. A lively IPA alternative without alcohol, best served cold with curries, BBQ or light meals.

name: Mikkeller Burst
description: Mikkeller Burst Free is a bright alcohol free IPA with plenty of hoppy character and a clean, refreshing finish. Based on Mikkeller’s Burst IPA, it keeps the citrus led profile but brings it into a lighter 0.3% ABV beer. Expect fresh citrus, orange pith and a slight bubble gum aroma, giving it that playful modern IPA feel.

name: Mikkeller Drink'in the Sun
description: Mikkeller Drink'in the Sun is a 0.3% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in Denmark. Bright golden and hazy with citrus, tropical fruit and pine hop notes, it has crisp refreshing finish over light malt body. A modern alcohol free pale ale, best served chilled with salads, curries or pizza.

name: Mikkeller Drink’in the Snow Winter Ale
description: Mikkeller Drink’in the Snow is a bold 0.3% alcohol free winter ale with plenty of cosy, malty character. It brings a richer style than many alcohol free beers, with dried fruit, orange peel, brown sugar, rye bread and gentle spice all working together in the glass.

name: Mikkeller Energibajer
description: Mikkeller Energibajer is a bright, refreshing alcohol free wheat ale from Denmark’s Mikkeller. Brewed at 0.3% ABV, it has a light, fruity profile with peach, apricot and herbal notes, followed by grapefruit hop freshness and a clean malty finish. This is a great choice when you want something softer than an IPA but more aromatic than a standard lager.

name: Mikkeller Limbo Riesling AF Sour
description: Mikkeller Limbo Riesling AF is a fresh, bright alcohol free sour beer with a lovely wine inspired twist. Made with Riesling grape juice from Mikkeller Vineyards, it brings crisp acidity, white grape character and a dry, refreshing finish. This is a brilliant choice for anyone who likes sharper, more grown up alcohol free drinks.

name: Mikkeller Weird Weather
description: Mikkeller Weird Weather is a 0.3% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in Denmark. Hazy golden with tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop aromas, it delivers juicy hop flavour over smooth malt base. A bold IPA alternative without alcohol, best enjoyed cold with burgers, BBQ or spicy dishes.

name: Moersleutel 'Motor Oil' Stout
description: Crafted by the innovative minds at Moersleutel, Motor Oil Alcohol Free is a powerhouse stout that defies expectations. With just 0.5% ABV, this alcohol-free version of their iconic stout delivers the same rich, indulgent experience without the buzz. Expect a velvety pour as dark as midnight, crowned with a creamy tan head.

name: Neumarkter Lammsbräu Bio
description: Neumarkter Lammsbräu Bio Alkoholfrei brings traditional German brewing and certified organic ingredients together in a satisfying alcohol free beer. Balanced malt provides a smooth and rounded foundation, while floral whole cone hops add freshness and a gently bitter edge.

name: Nirvana Bavarian Hefeweizen
description: Experience the authentic taste of Bavaria with Nirvana Brewery's Traditional Bavarian Hefeweizen. This 0.3% ABV non-alcoholic wheat beer is brewed to a traditional Bavarian recipe, offering a fresh, light, and easy-drinking experience. Aromas of vanilla and bubble gum lead to subtle hints of banana and clove, making this unfiltered wheat beer a refreshing choice for warm summer evenings.

name: Nirvana Best Amber Ale 0.5%
description: Nirvana Best is a 0.5% ABV alcohol-free amber ale brewed in London, inspired by the classic British best bitter. Crafted with Maris Otter and Amber malts, alongside Goldings hops, it delivers layers of biscuit, caramel, and toasted nut flavours, balanced by gentle, earthy hop notes.

name: Nirvana Best Bitter
description: Nirvana Best 0.5% is an alcohol free best bitter brewed in the UK by Nirvana Brewery, specialists in alcohol free beer. Inspired by classic British pub bitters, it is malt led and gently balanced, aiming to recreate the feel of a traditional amber ale without the alcohol.

name: Nirvana Brewery Pils
description: Nirvana Pils is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pilsner brewed in London. Golden with crisp malt character, floral hop aroma and clean refreshing finish, it mirrors traditional pilsner style. Best served cold in a tall glass with salads, pizza or grilled food.

name: Nirvana Buttercup Double Dry Hopped Pale Ale
description: Nirvana Buttercup is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic double dry hopped pale ale brewed in London. Golden and hazy with citrus, tropical fruit and pine hop notes, it delivers bold hoppy flavour over smooth malt base. A modern craft pale ale without alcohol, best served chilled with pizza, burgers or spicy dishes.

name: Nirvana Cloudy Lemon Lager
description: Nirvana Cloudy Lemon Lager 0.2% is an alcohol free lager brewed in the UK by Nirvana Brewery, specialists in alcohol free beer. Light, crisp, and deliberately refreshing, it combines a clean lager base with real lemon for natural citrus character rather than sweetness.

name: Nirvana Hazy Grapefruit Lager
description: Nirvana Hazy Grapefruit Lager is a 0.3% alcohol free lager with a bright citrus twist. It brings together soft lager malt, gentle haze and a lively grapefruit character for a beer that feels crisp, fresh and easy to drink. The grapefruit adds a sharp, juicy edge without making it too sweet, keeping the finish clean and refreshing.

name: Nirvana Mocha
description: Nirvana Mocha Alcohol Free Porter is a 0.5% ABV alcohol free porter crafted for depth and richness. Built around roasted malt, dark coffee and chocolate notes, it offers a smooth, rounded body that feels indulgent without alcohol. Layers of mocha and subtle nutty hints create real complexity, making this a great choice for darker beer lovers who still want satisfying flavour.

name: Nirvana Stout Smooth & Dark
description: Nirvana Stout Smooth & Dark 0.5% is an alcohol free stout brewed in the UK by Nirvana Brewery, specialising exclusively in alcohol free beer. Designed to mirror classic stout character, it uses roasted malts to deliver depth without heaviness. The result is smooth, dark, and rounded, with enough body to feel satisfying while staying easy to drink.

name: Nirvana West Coast IPA
description: Brewed by Nirvana Brewery , West Coast IPA is a 0.5% alcohol free beer inspired by the classic American style. Expect bright citrus, pine and resin hop character layered over a clean malt backbone, with firm bitterness and a dry finish. True to the West Coast profile, it focuses on clarity, structure and hop expression rather than sweetness.

name: Nittenauer Lola Coffee Porter
description: Nittenauer Lola Coffee Porter is a rich and aromatic alcohol free dark beer from Bavaria, brewed by the expert team at Brauerei Nittenauer. Crafted with roasted malts and freshly brewed coffee, it brings deep espresso and dark chocolate notes supported by smooth caramel sweetness.

name: Northern Monk Holy Faith
description: Northern Monk Holy Faith is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in the UK. Hazy golden with tropical fruit, citrus and pine hop character, it offers juicy refreshing taste with smooth finish. A modern alcohol free pale ale, best enjoyed chilled with curries, burgers or BBQ.

name: NuWave Grapefruit Lagerade Citrus Lager
description: NuWave Grapefruit Lagerade blends the clean, refreshing character of alcohol‑free lager with a bright grapefruit twist. Light and citrus‑forward, it delivers a crisp, tangy bite balanced by gentle bitterness and a refreshing finish. Crafted as a functional alcohol‑free beer, it’s infused with botanicals and biotics designed to support mood and gut health, giving you the social lift of a drink, without alcohol or the next‑day fog.

name: NuWave Mood Enhancing
description: This non alcoholic pale ale brings a bright, refreshing hop character in an easy drinking style. It has a clean golden body with gentle bitterness and soft citrus notes, making it a simple everyday choice when you want the feel of a beer without the alcohol. The flavour stays light and balanced, keeping things session friendly and smooth.

name: NuWave Passionfruit Lagerade Tropical Lager
description: NuWave Passionfruit Lagerade blends the clean, refreshing character of alcohol‑free lager with bright passionfruit flavour for a vibrant, tropical twist. Light, crisp and gently fruity, it delivers refreshing flavour with a subtle sweetness and a smooth, easy finish.

name: Ollenaut Omnipollo Pleroma Brunch Bomb
description: Brewed by Omnipollo , Pleroma Non Alcoholic Brunch Bomb is a 0.5% stout inspired by indulgent brunch flavours. Dark, expressive and full flavoured, it delivers roasted malt depth layered with sweet, dessert like richness. Despite its alcohol free format, it keeps a rounded body and satisfying intensity that fans of bold stouts expect.

name: Ollenaut Õllenaut Kaineken Citra Pale Ale
description: Õllenaut Kaineken Citra Pale Ale is a 0.5% ABV Estonian non alcoholic pale ale. Golden and hazy with citrus, tropical fruit and pine hop notes from Citra hops, it offers juicy refreshing flavour over smooth malt body. Best served cold with spicy food or pizza.

name: Ollenaut Õllenaut Kaineken Pale Ale
description: Õllenaut Kaineken Pale Ale is a 0.5% ABV Estonian non alcoholic pale ale. Pale golden with citrus, tropical fruit and floral hop aromas, it offers refreshing flavour with smooth malt body. A versatile pale ale without alcohol, best served chilled with pizza, salads or BBQ.

name: Omnipollo Bianca Godfeather Lassi Gose
description: Omnipollo Bianca Non-Alcoholic Godfeather Lassi Gose is no ordinary alcohol free beer. Thick, fruity and unapologetically indulgent, it brings Omnipollo’s dessert-inspired Bianca style into a 0.3% ABV sour. Blueberries and raspberries bring plenty of sweet and tart berry flavour, while juicy pineapple adds a brighter tropical edge.

name: Omnipollo Maz
description: Maz Non-Alcoholic IPA takes off from their favourite Pale Ale, Maz Oat Pale, but with only 0.3 % of the ABV. Still brewed with the same focus on hoppiness and drinkability, but without the alcohol.

name: Omnipollo Noa Pecan Mud Cake Imperial Stout
description: Brewed by Omnipollo , Noa Pecan Mud Cake Non Alcoholic Imperial Stout brings the brewery’s cult dessert stout into 0.5% form. Inspired by rich pecan mud cake, it layers deep roasted malt with chocolate, nutty sweetness and dark dessert notes. Despite being alcohol free, it keeps a dense, indulgent character and satisfying body that fans of imperial stouts expect.

name: Omnipollo Perikles
description: Omnipollo Perikles Non-Alcoholic brings the Swedish brewery’s house pilsner into a lighter alcohol free can. Originally created for Omnipollos Hatt, it is brewed with oats and unmalted wheat to give this crisp lager a softer, more satisfying body. Expect clean pilsner refreshment with delicate floral and herbal hop notes, soft grain and a gently bitter finish.

name: Otter Zero IPA
description: Just 0.5% ABV Otter Zero is a refreshing low‑alcohol IPA brewed with a blend of English and US hops to deliver bright citrus, stone fruit and gentle bitter notes. With a spicy hop aroma and a naturally balanced malt base, it packs full IPA character at under 0.5% ABV.

name: Paulaner Hefe-Weißbier Beer
description: Brewed in Munich, Germany | 100% Natural | Isotonic | Vegan-Friendly Experience the unmistakable taste of a classic Bavarian wheat beer—without the alcohol. Paulaner Hefe-Weißbier 0.0% is a masterfully brewed non-alcoholic beer that delivers all the fruity, yeasty, and refreshing character of a traditional Weissbier, with none of the buzz.

name: Paulaner Weißbier
description: Paulaner Weibbier is a 0.5% ABV German alcohol free wheat beer. Pale golden with banana, clove and spice yeast aromas, it offers smooth refreshing finish. A traditional Bavarian-style wheat beer brewed without alcohol, best served in a tall weizen glass with sausages or pretzels.

name: Paulaner Wheat Beer German Hefeweizen
description: Paulaner Hefe-Weibbier Non-Alcoholic is a 0.5% ABV German wheat beer. Hazy golden with banana, clove and soft spice aromas, it delivers smooth body and refreshing finish. Brewed under purity law, it is also isotonic and vitamin-rich, popular for social drinking and sports recovery.

name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro Arancia Rossa Blood Orange
description: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Arancia Rossa brings a splash of Italian sunshine to the alcohol free beer fridge. Created as one of Peroni's first flavoured 0.0% beers in the UK, Arancia Rossa combines the crisp, refreshing character of Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% with the juicy flavour of Italian blood orange.

name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro Limone di Sicilia
description: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Limone di Sicilia brings together classic Italian refreshment and the bright flavour of Sicilian lemons. One of Peroni's first flavoured 0.0% beers in the UK, Limone di Sicilia combines 65% alcohol free beer with 35% lemonade, including lemon juice and natural lemon flavouring.

name: Pivot Modern Lager Vegan Crisp & Refreshing
description: Pivot Modern Lager is a crisp, contemporary alcohol-free lager built for modern drinking - clean, bright, and full-flavoured without compromise. A light malt backbone meets a burst of fresh hops, delivering aroma, balance, and refreshing drinkability in every sip.

name: Pivot Beer Modern Lager
description: Brewed by Pivot Beer , Modern Lager is an alcohol free lager brewed to 0.5% ABV with a focus on balance and drinkability. It delivers a crisp, straightforward profile with light malt character and a clean finish, keeping things refreshing rather than heavy. Designed as an everyday option, it works well when you want something cold, uncomplicated, and genuinely lager like.

name: Pohjala Põhjala Treeninglaager
description: Põhjala Treeninglaager 0% is an alcohol free lager brewed as a refreshing, easy drinking beer with balance at its core. Light malt provides a clean grain backbone, while restrained hopping keeps the profile crisp and dry rather than bitter. Designed as a post activity or everyday refresher, it focuses on clarity, drinkability and simplicity, delivering classic lager character without alcohol.

name: Pohjala Põhjala Treeninglaager Citrus Lager
description: Põhjala Treeninglaager Citrus 0% is an alcohol free lager brewed with added citrus for extra freshness and lift. A light malt base provides clean grain character, while the citrus addition brings a bright, zesty edge that keeps the beer sharp and refreshing. Dry on the finish and easy drinking, it is designed for simple refreshment and balance, delivering classic lager clarity with a subtle citrus twist and no alcohol.

name: Prime Time ZERO
description: Prime Time ZERO is a 0.5% alcohol free lager brewed in Britain for clean refreshment and easy drinking. The brewery describes it as smooth and well balanced, with subtle malt sweetness, gentle hop bitterness and a clean finish, while also adding magnesium and vitamin B12 to support muscle function, focus and recovery.

name: Quantock QuAF Pale Ale
description: QuAF 0.5% Pale Ale is Quantock Brewery's take on a modern low-alcohol pale ale, delivering full-strength flavour without the full-strength ABV. Brewed on a light pale malt base with a unique low-alcohol yeast strain, QuAF bursts with vibrant white grape, gooseberry, and citrus notes, creating a refreshing and seriously drinkable pale ale that's true to Quantock's hop-forward brewing style.

name: Queer Brewing 'BOLD' Pale Ale
description: BOLD is Queer Brewing’s flagship alcohol‑free pale ale - vibrant, expressive, and unapologetically full of flavour. Brewed to stand proudly on its own (not as a compromise), this 0.5% pale ale delivers bright hop character, soft haze, and a refreshing, modern finish.

name: Rodenbach Fruitage Belgian Fruit
description: Rodenbach Fruitage 0.0% is a bright Belgian alcohol free fruit beer with a refreshing sweet and sour character. Made with 100% natural ingredients, it brings together rich red fruit flavour, gentle sweetness and Rodenbach’s fresh, lightly tart edge. It is fruity, lively and very easy to drink, making it a great choice if you want something lighter and more refreshing than a standard beer.

name: Rothaus Hefeweizen
description: The Rothaus Hefeweizen has a reputation for being one of the finest examples of the style on the planet. With such high acclaim, its no surprise they developed an extraordinary, alcohol-free version. Pouring a strong copper colour with a slight cloudiness. Aromas of fresh straw, caramel, honey and banana.

name: Rothaus Pils
description: During the production of the pils alcohol-free, the alcohol is extracted through a very special process. The beer aroma is thus retained. The Rothaus system removes the alcohol with steam under vacuum. In the following, the aromas are recovered particularly gently and remain in the beer.

name: Rothaus Tannenzäpfle Pilsner
description: Rothaus Tannenzäpfle Alkoholfrei is a 0.5% ABV German non alcoholic pilsner. Pale golden with crisp malt body, floral hops and refreshing dry finish, it delivers authentic pilsner character. Best served cold with German dishes or light snacks.

name: Samuel Smiths Brown Ale
description: Samuel Smiths Brown Ale is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic ale brewed in the UK. Deep amber with caramel malt, nutty character and light hop bitterness, it delivers smooth balanced finish. Brewed with traditional methods, best served at 10-12°C with cheese, roasts or pub snacks.

name: San Miguel 0.0 Lager
description: San Miguel 0.0 is a classic alcohol-free lager brewed with the same dedication and ingredients as its full-strength counterpart. With a light malt body , gentle bitterness , and a clean, refreshing finish, it’s perfect for sunny afternoons, tapas moments, or anytime you want the taste of Spain without the alcohol .

name: San Miguel 0.0 Radler
description: San Miguel 0.0 Radler is a 0.0% ABV Spanish alcohol free beer blended with lemon. Pale golden and hazy with citrus zest, crisp malt and refreshing finish, it delivers light and zesty taste. A summery option best served chilled in a tall glass with salads or seafood.

name: Schneider Weisse Beer
description: You can tell its strength by its colour alone: "Schneider Weisse non-alcoholic" - the slightly darker, isotonic thirst-quencher energizes with 100% wheat beer taste at less than 0,5% alcohol. That's how a "free" wheat beer should taste like: strong - just like Bavaria.

name: Schneider Wheat
description: Schneider Weisse Alkoholfrei is a 0.5% ABV German non alcoholic wheat beer. Hazy amber with banana, clove and light spice aromas, it offers smooth body and refreshing finish. Brewed under purity law, best served in a tall glass with sausages or cheese.

name: Sierra Nevada Trail Pass Brewveza
description: Sierra Nevada Trail Pass Brewveza is an alcohol free beer brewed for easy refreshment, sitting below 0.5% ABV. It has a light blonde beer profile with a clean malt base, gentle bitterness and a crisp finish. Brewed with Bravo, Cascade and Centennial hops, it keeps enough hop character to feel like a proper Sierra Nevada beer without becoming heavy.

name: Siren Last Light Low Alcohol Nitro Stout Craft Brew
description: Last Light is a low alcohol nitro stout brewed in the style of a classic Irish dry stout, with an ABV of 0.5%. It pours deep black with a dense, creamy head and delivers familiar flavours of roasted barley, coffee and subtle dark chocolate. The nitro carbonation creates a smooth, velvety mouthfeel that sets it apart from standard alcohol free stouts.

name: SiWC Honey Badger Wheat
description: SiWC Honey Badger Wheat Beer is a 0.5% gluten free non alcoholic wheat beer from Sheep in Wolf’s Clothing Brewery in Scotland. It delivers a soft, rounded wheat body with bright citrus notes and gentle spice, giving it the classic character of a wheat beer without the alcohol.

name: SiWC Lager Day Saints
description: SiWC Lager Day Saints is a 0.5% non alcoholic Munich Helles lager from Sheep in Wolf’s Clothing Brewery in Dunblane, Scotland. Brewed using traditional methods, it delivers the clean, crisp refreshment you want from a lager, with gentle malt character and a balanced finish.

name: SiWC Memento Mori Hazy IPA
description: SiWC Memento Mori Hazy IPA is a 0.5% non alcoholic hazy IPA from Sheep in Wolf’s Clothing Brewery in Scotland. It brings a soft, juicy profile with tropical fruit, citrus and a light haze that gives it a smooth, rounded feel. The bitterness is gentle, keeping the focus on fruit and drinkability, with a clean finish that makes it easy to come back to.

name: Slaapmutske Sunny Moon Hop Juice
description: Slaapmutske Sunny Moon Hop Juice is a bright Belgian alcohol free beer with a fresh, fruity character and a light blond pour. Brewed by Slaapmutske at 0.3% ABV, it is made with barley malt and dry hopping for a crisp, aromatic finish. Expect citrus, gentle fruit and a soft bitter edge, with a light sparkle that makes it feel fresh and easy to drink.

name: St Austell Proper Job
description: St Austell Proper Job 0.5% is a Cornish non alcoholic IPA. Golden amber with bold citrus, tropical fruit and pine hop aromas, it delivers firm bitterness over smooth malt body. A refreshing IPA alternative best enjoyed chilled with spicy dishes, curries or BBQ.

name: Stewart Brewing 'Scot Free Lager
description: Enjoy the refreshing taste of lager—without the full-strength alcohol. Stewart Brewing’s Scot Free is a finely balanced alcohol-free lager (0.5% ABV) brewed in the heart of Scotland. It delivers a classic, crisp malt character with a gentle hop bitterness and a satisfyingly smooth finish.

name: Stiegl Lager
description: Brewed by Stieglbrauerei zu Salzburg , Stiegl Lager 0.0% alkoholfrei delivers classic Austrian lager character without alcohol. Expect a bright golden pour, soft grainy malt notes and a balanced, gentle hop bitterness that keeps the finish crisp and refreshing. True to traditional brewing principles, it focuses on clarity, structure and drinkability rather than sweetness.

name: Supreme Beer Experience
description: Discover the Supreme Non-Alcoholic Beer Experience with Our Mixed Beer Box Embark on a flavourful journey through the world of non-alcoholic beers with our meticulously curated Mixed Beer Box. Designed for those eager to explore a variety of alcohol-free brews, this selection offers a diverse range of styles and tastes, ensuring there’s something to delight every palate.

name: Surréaliste Abstinence Absolue
description: Surréaliste Abstinence Absolue is a juicy Belgian alcohol free IPA with the bold, playful character you would expect from Brasserie Surréaliste. Brewed with rye and hopped with Citra, Nelson and Amarillo, it brings bright citrus, exotic fruit and a refreshing bitter finish.

name: Tartarus Sylph New England IPA
description: Tartarus Sylph is a soft, hazy 0.5% alcohol free New England IPA from Tartarus Beers in Leeds. Brewed with wheat and oats, it has a smooth, rounded body that gives it more texture than a lighter alcohol free pale. The hop bill brings plenty of fruit. Citra, Nectaron and Enigma deliver bright citrus, passionfruit, peach, melon and red berry notes, giving the beer that juicy modern IPA feel without leaning too bitter.

name: Tempest Brewing Co Lagerita AF Sour
description: Brewed by Tempest Brewing Co , Lagerita AF Sour is an inventive alcohol free beer inspired by the classic Lagerita cocktail. At 0.5% ABV, it blends sharp citrus zest and a hint of salt with a lively sour base for a thirst-quenching character. Designed to feel fresh and vibrant, this beer cuts through the ordinary with its bright acidity and clean finish.

name: Tempest Brewing Sleight of Hand
description: Sleight of Hand is an alcohol free sour pale ale from Tempest Brewing Co in Scotland that feels crisp, lively and refreshing. It balances bright citrus and tropical fruit characters with a touch of tart acidity and light malt sweetness. The body is vibrant with bright hop notes rather than heaviness, making it easy to drink and engaging from first sip to finish.

name: Tempest Face Hopper AF IPA
description: Brewed by Tempest Brewing , Face Hopper is a hazy, alcohol free IPA brewed to 0.5 % ABV with a focus on juicy hop character and satisfying mouthfeel. It uses flaked oats and wheat to give a fuller body than some other alcohol free beers, and hops like Chinook, Citra and Krush deliver bold citrus and tropical notes that echo many full-strength IPAs.

name: Ter Dolen IPA Op De Dool
description: Ter Dolen IPA Op De Dool is a Belgian alcohol free IPA with proper hop character and a refreshing bitter edge. Brewed by Kasteelbrouwerij De Dool, it brings the feel of a modern IPA into a lighter 0.3% bottle. Dry hopping gives it subtle citrus and grapefruit notes, while the malt base keeps it rounded and drinkable.

name: Theakston's 'Nowt Peculier' Dark Ale Beer
description: Nowt Peculier is the alcohol-free version of Theakston’s iconic Old Peculier , brewed in Masham, North Yorkshire. Using advanced filtration technology , it preserves the rich, dark character of the original—without the alcohol. Expect a deeply satisfying ale with subtle notes of cherry, banana, and roasted malt , perfect for traditional ale lovers seeking a zero-ABV option.

name: To Øl Implosion
description: To Øl Implosion is a 0.3 % ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in Denmark. Light-bodied yet full of flavour, it combines citrusy hops with a crisp malt base for a refreshing alcohol free beer experience. Vegan friendly, it showcases To Øl’s creative brewing style in a low-alcohol format.

name: To Øl Implosion PINK Fruited Sour
description: This non alcoholic fruited sour from To Øl is brewed using kettle souring to deliver a bright, clean tang without heaviness. Lychee brings soft tropical fruit and gentle sweetness, while hibiscus adds floral lift and a crisp, refreshing edge. The balance stays sharp and lively rather than aggressive, making it easy to drink while still full of character.

name: Track Brewing Sonoma AF Pale Ale
description: Brewed by Track Brewing Co , Sonoma AF is the 0.5% alcohol free take on their well known Sonoma Pale Ale. It keeps the bright citrus character driven by Citra hops while maintaining a light, balanced body and clean finish. Designed to reflect the clarity and freshness of the original, it delivers grapefruit zest, soft tropical notes and gentle bitterness in an easy drinking format.

name: Trail Pass Golden Ale
description: Trail Pass Golden Ale is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in the USA. Golden amber with citrus zest, floral hops and smooth malt body, it delivers refreshing balanced flavour. A versatile pale ale best served cold with burgers, salads or BBQ.

name: Trail Pass IPA
description: Trail Pass IPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in the USA. Golden and hazy with citrus, pine and tropical hop character, it delivers bold hoppy flavour with smooth malt balance. A refreshing IPA alternative best served chilled with spicy dishes, pizza or curries.

name: Troubadour Zestra Belgian Blonde
description: Troubadour Zestra is a lively Belgian alcohol free blonde beer from The Musketeers. Brewed at 0.3% ABV, it brings a bright, zesty character with hop bitterness, fruity notes and soft maltiness all working together in the glass. The name Zestra nods to citrus zest, and that fits the beer beautifully.

name: Twice Brewed Dog On A Skateboard AF Hazy IPA
description: Dog On A Skateboard is Twice Brewed’s playful, modern alcohol‑free hazy IPA, brewed to deliver big, bright hop flavour with minimal bitterness. Packed with cutting‑edge hop varieties, it bursts with notes of pineapple and stone fruit, balanced by a smooth, hazy body and a clean, refreshing finish.

name: Twice Brewed Once Pale Ale
description: Once Brewed Pale Ale is Twice Brewed’s clean, modern alcohol‑free pale, brewed to deliver crisp citrus character and easy‑drinking balance at just 0.5% ABV. Light, refreshing and sessionable, it combines gentle malt sweetness with bright hop notes of citrus and pine.

name: Twice Brewed Slipway Hazy IPA St Ives Beer Vegan
description: Slipway 0.5% Hazy IPA from St Ives Brewery is a smooth, modern alcohol‑free IPA brewed in Cornwall. Lightly hazy and packed with juicy hop character, it delivers soft tropical notes and refreshing drinkability with just 0.5% ABV. Easy‑going yet flavourful, Slipway balances bright hop expression with a clean, sessionable finish, perfect for relaxed, mindful drinking.

name: UNLTD. IPA
description: IPA is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic IPA brewed in the UK. Golden and hazy with citrus zest, tropical fruit and pine hop notes, it offers bold hoppy flavour with refreshing finish. Low calorie, vegan and gluten free, best served chilled with spicy dishes or curries.

name: UNLTD. IPA Pint
description: UNLTD Alcohol‑Free IPA is a modern, hop‑forward IPA brewed for flavour, balance, and drinkability - now in a proper pint can for long, laid‑back sessions. Brewed to strength using controlled fermentation, it naturally finishes at 0.5% ABV, keeping the body and bitterness you expect from a great IPA, without the alcohol.

name: Utopian Brewing 'AF Pilsner' Lager
description: Best Before 19/10/2026 - Still tastes great Enjoy the crisp, refreshing taste of Utopian Brewing's AF Pilsner, an alcohol-free lager that delivers the classic pilsner experience without the alcohol. Made with British-grown barley and hops, and cold-fermented with authentic lager yeast, this unfiltered beer boasts a smooth malt profile and a gentle hop finish.

name: Valduc Angelo Belgian Blonde
description: Valduc Angelo is a light and refreshing Belgian alcohol free blonde beer from Brasserie Valduc-Thor. Smooth, fruity and easy to drink, it brings the feel of a classic Belgian craft beer into a lighter 0.4% bottle. Expect a pale blond pour with gentle malt, soft fruitiness and a rounded, balanced finish.

name: vandeStreek Bumper Blond
description: vandeStreek Bumper Blond is a 0.5 % ABV alcohol free blond ale from Utrecht, Netherlands. Brewed with Cascade and Amarillo hops, it combines a classic blond style with modern citrus hop character. The result is a refreshing, easy drinking beer with plenty of flavour and no alcohol.

name: vandeStreek Fun House NEIPA
description: vandeStreek Fun House is a 0.5 % ABV alcohol free New England IPA brewed in Utrecht, Netherlands. Packed with American hops including Mosaic and Citra, it delivers the juicy, hazy character of a modern NEIPA without alcohol. Vegan friendly, it offers bold hop flavour and soft mouthfeel for a satisfying craft beer experience.

name: vandeStreek Grapefruit IPA
description: vandeStreek Grapefruit IPA is a bright, punchy alcohol free IPA with a proper citrus bite. Brewed with grapefruit to lean into the natural bitterness of the hops, it gives you that sharp, zesty fruit character that works so well in modern IPA. This is not a soft, sweet fruit beer.

name: vandeStreek Playground
description: vandeStreek Playground is a 0.5 % ABV alcohol free IPA brewed in Utrecht, Netherlands. Made with five varieties of American hops, it delivers vibrant flavour with a bold craft beer character. Vegan friendly, it has become one of Europe’s most acclaimed alcohol free IPAs, offering all the hop punch without the alcohol.

name: Vault City Stoopid AF Tropical Smoothie Sour
description: Vault City Stoopid AF is what happens when alcohol free beer stops playing it safe. This bold tropical smoothie sour packs a generous 440ml can with unfermented fruit, bringing together luscious banana, juicy peach and mouth watering mango with vanilla and coconut cream.

name: Vinohradský 12
description: Vinohradský Vinohradská 12 Non Alcoholic is the alcohol free version of the brewery’s premium Czech lager, produced using membrane technology. The brewery describes the full strength Vinohradská 12 as a golden lager brewed in the best traditions using a double mash process, with Žatecký poloraný červeňák, better known as Saaz, and Sládek hops for balanced bitterness and a fine hop aroma.

name: Viven Nada IPA
description: Viven Nada IPA is a bright Belgian alcohol free IPA with proper hop character and a fresh, summery finish. Brewed by Viven at 0.3% ABV, it brings the feel of a classic IPA without the full strength alcohol. It has a soft, full bodied character, balanced by aroma hops and American bitter hops.

name: We Be Friends Cloudy Krush Lemon Sour
description: We Can Be Friends Cloudy Krush is a 0.5% alcohol free sour brewed in collaboration with Vault City. Built on a mixed fermentation sour base, it is conditioned on Sicilian lemons, lemon zest and fresh orange juice for a bright citrus led profile. A generous dry hop of Krush T90 and Azacca Cryo adds tropical and stone fruit character, giving the beer a juicy edge that balances the tartness.

name: We Be Friends Voodoo
description: We Can Be Friends Voodoo is a big, bright alcohol free IPA with proper hop character and plenty of citrus bite. Brewed with fresh crop Motueka at several stages of the brew, it brings lime, bitter candied orange and tropical fruit over a fluffy, full bodied base.

name: We Can Be Friends Makemake x We Be High Five And Fly
description: High Five And Fly is a big, juicy alcohol free IPA brewed by Makemake in collaboration with We Can Be Friends. It brings proper craft beer energy in a 500ml can, with a heavy dose of hops, bright citrus and soft stone fruit character. This is the kind of alcohol free IPA that does not feel like a compromise.

name: We Can Be Friends Pomona Island Nothing To Get Hung About
description: Pomona Island Nothing To Get Hung About proves that lowering the alcohol does not mean holding back on the hops. Created with alcohol free brewing specialists We Can Be Friends, this pale ale delivers bright, juicy flavour at just 0.5% ABV. Cryo Mosaic, Amplifire Riwaka and Citra provide the hop character, creating a refreshing combination described as lemon and lime soda pop.

name: Whiplash Never Drinking Again
description: Whiplash Never Drinking Again is a hazy alcohol free IPA with loads of juicy flavour and a really satisfying finish. It brings together bright citrus, gooseberry, apricot and tropical fruit, all wrapped up in a soft creamy body that makes it feel far more substantial than most alcohol free beers.

name: Williams Bros Brew 'Caesar AF' Lager/ IPA Hybrid
description: This alcohol-free version of Caesar Augustus, their award-winning Lager/IPA hybrid has all the crisp, clean notes of the finest lager with the discrete bitter finish of a well-balanced IPA. About The Brewery Williams Bros. is located in Alloa, Clackmannanshire and is set in the old George Youngers bottling hall in Kelliebank.

name: Williams Bros Brew 'Joker AF' Wickedly Hoppy IPA
description: The Alcohol-Free version of Joker IPA remains wickedly hoppy but uses a Thiolised yeast to unlock a fuller fruit flavour to balance the bitter/sweet bite. Sure to still put a smile on your face...even the day after! About The Brewery Williams Bros. is located in Alloa, Clackmannanshire and is set in the old George Youngers bottling hall in Kelliebank.

name: Wiper and True Tomorrow Lager Crisp, Clean & Refreshing
description: Wiper and True Tomorrow Alcohol-Free Lager is a beautifully balanced beer that delivers all the refreshment of a classic lager without the high alcohol. Brewed with premium malts and delicate hops, it offers a smooth, biscuity backbone and a gentle floral lift. Perfect for easy drinking, summer sessions, or any moment that calls for crisp, clean refreshment.

name: Wiper And True Kaleidoscope
description: Wiper and True Kaleidoscope is a 0.5% ABV non alcoholic pale ale brewed in Bristol. Golden amber with citrus zest, tropical fruit and floral hop character, it delivers refreshing flavour with smooth malt body. A craft pale ale best served chilled with pizza, salads or BBQ.

name: Wiper and True Wildling Hazy New England Pale Ale
description: Wiper and True Wildling Alcohol Free <0.5% is a hazy New England style pale ale brewed to deliver full flavour without alcohol. Bursting with sun-drenched peach and nectarine, it is layered with citrus brightness and soft berry aromas. The body is smooth and rounded, allowing the hop character to shine without sharp bitterness.

name: Woodforde's 0.5 Low Alcohol Pale Ale
description: Woodforde's 0.5 is a refreshing low alcohol pale ale brewed in the heart of Norfolk. Smooth, balanced and packed with character, it delivers bright tropical citrus flavours, gentle pine notes and a crisp, clean finish. Formerly known as VOLT 0.5, this award-winning beer retains exactly the same liquid inside, just with a fresh new look and name.

name: Zeer Brewing Ollie Steazy Pilsner
description: OLLIE – Steazy Pilsner is Zeer Brewing’s effortlessly drinkable take on a classic German pilsner. Clean, crisp, and unapologetically stylish, Ollie delivers everything you want from a pilsner: light malt character, gentle noble hop bitterness, and a refreshing dry finish — all without the alcohol.

name: Zeer Brewing ZIPA Sundays at Grandma’s IPA
description: ZIPA – Sundays at Grandma’s IPA is the beer that started it all for Zeer Brewing. Designed to feel comforting yet vibrant, it’s a classic, hop‑forward alcohol‑free IPA with a clean malt base, lively bitterness, and a refreshingly crisp finish. Brewed using Zeer’s low‑alcohol fermentation (never dealcoholised), ZIPA delivers proper IPA character without the alcohol.

name: Zeevonk Blond Belgian
description: Zeevonk Blond 0.4% is a Belgian alcohol free blond beer with a fresh, floral character and a smooth malt body. Based on Zeevonk Blond, it keeps the easy drinking feel of the original while bringing the alcohol down to 0.4%. It pours blond, with a floral aroma, fresh lift and rounded malt flavour.

name: Zeven Zonden Avaritia Low Alcohol Belgian Blond
description: Zeven Zonden Avaritia is a Belgian low alcohol blond beer with a light, refreshing character and a surprisingly full flavour. Brewed by Hugel at The Brew Society, it is part of the Zeven Zonden range and brings a softer, more aromatic take on alcohol free Belgian beer.

description: Best Before - 01/08/2026 - Still tastes great Crisp refreshment. VETO PAUSE is a premium alcohol-free lager brewed for full-flavour refreshment without compromise.
